scripts.setup: node apps/api/scripts/setup-local.mjs && npm run db:up --workspace @dokimos/api && npm run db:seed --workspace @dokimos/api
scripts.dev: npm run db:up --workspace @dokimos/api && npm run build --workspace @dokimos/shared && concurrently -k -c auto -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace @dokimos/api" "npm run dev --workspace @dokimos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @dokimos/shared && npm run build --workspace @dokimos/api && npm run build --workspace @dokimos/web
scripts.review:dev: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @dokimos/shared && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.test.json
